description: This Java class provides helper methods and utilities to convert various types of ThingEvent instances into Thing objects, as well as merging Thing data with extra fields within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ThingEventToThingConverter
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods to convert various ThingEvent types to Thing objects and to merge Thing data with extra fields.

methods.name: thingEventToThing
methods.description: Creates a Thing from a given ThingEvent by utilizing a mapping of event classes to conversion functions.

methods.name: mergeThingWithExtraFields
methods.description: Merges a Thing extracted from a Signal event with additional fields if available, prioritizing the Signal-provided Thing data.
